doc: A (3, 2) float64 field: rows at 60, 0 and -60 degrees, weights 0.5, 1, 0.5. rtol 1e-9. Arguments: a, the field (h, w), north-up. Weights: c_i = cos(lat_i) at the cell centres of grid_lonlat(w, h), row i at lat_i = 90 deg - (i + 0.5) 180 deg / h (row 0 is north, float64 radians pi/2 - (i + 0.5) pi / h); result = sum_i(mean_j a[i, j] c_i) / sum_i c_i, a float64 scalar stored as a one-element array. The row mean runs in the dtype of a (float32 rows are averaged in float32, numpy pairwise summation), the weighting in float64. Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 4.4e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is more than 1e5 times that spread.
